q: 我是昨天晚上发烧___。
en: I got a fever last night.

q: 这台电脑是在网上___的。
en: I bought this computer online.

q: 妈妈是昨天下午___我去医院的。
en: Mum took me to the hospital yesterday afternoon.

q: 我是用手机___的这个视频。
en: I filmed this video with my phone.

q: 弟弟是___奶奶一起去医院的。
en: My younger brother went to the hospital with Grandma.

q: 他___上个星期感冒的，现在还没好。
en: He caught the cold last week, and he is still not better.

q: 我是一个人坐两个小时的火车来看病___，家人都不知道。
en: I came to see a doctor alone, taking a two-hour train, and my family does not know.

q: 我是去年夏天在医院认识我先生___，那时候我在那儿当护士。
en: I met my husband at the hospital last summer, when I was working there as a nurse.

q: 这个手机___我哥哥买的。
en: My older brother bought this phone.

q: 我今天是来看医生___。
en: I came today to see the doctor.

q: 他___为了给奶奶看病才搬到上海的。
en: He moved to Shanghai only in order to get treatment for his grandmother.

q: 这张照片是谁用手机拍___？
en: Who took this photo with a phone?

q: 我不是来找医生的，我是来给朋友___东西的。
en: I did not come to see the doctor; I came to bring something for a friend.

q: 你是在哪儿看___病？
en: Where did you see the doctor?

q: 他是上个月回___。
en: He came back last month.

q: 我是在网上买___这双鞋，不是在商店。
en: I bought these shoes online, not in a shop.

q: 他是昨天在网上给我发___短信。
en: It was yesterday, online, that he sent me the message.

q: 他是昨天夜里一个人从医院走回___的，没有坐车。
en: He walked back from the hospital alone last night and did not take a car.

q: 你在哪儿买___？这个手机真好看。
en: Where did you buy it? This phone looks great.

q: 这___我昨天在网上买的，用了两次就坏了。
en: I bought this online yesterday, and it broke after two uses.

q: 我的手机在网上买___，比商店便宜两百块。
en: I bought my phone online, and it was 200 yuan cheaper than in a shop.

q: 这个软件___我朋友推荐给我的，不是我自己找到的。
en: This software was recommended to me by my friend; I did not find it myself.

q: 我___是坐飞机来的，我是坐火车来的。
en: I did not come by plane; I came by train.

q: 这部手机___是我买___，是我姐姐买的。
en: I did not buy this phone; my older sister did.

q: 我不是在医院出生___，是在家里。
en: I was not born in a hospital; I was born at home.

q: 他___是昨天晚上头疼的，已经疼了三天了。
en: His headache did not start last night; it has hurt for three days.

q: 这个视频不___我在网上下载的，是我朋友发给我的。
en: I did not download this video online; my friend sent it to me.

q: 我昨天买___一个新手机。
en: I bought a new phone yesterday.

q: 我的手机坏了，是我昨天在地铁上摔___。
en: My phone is broken; I dropped it on the subway yesterday.

q: 医生，我昨天头疼___，今天又发烧了。
en: Doctor, I had a headache yesterday and today I have a fever again.

q: 这台电脑很新，___上个星期买的。
en: This computer is very new; I bought it last week.

q: 我昨天在网上买___一台电脑，是朋友推荐的牌子。
en: I bought a computer online yesterday; it is a brand a friend recommended.

q: 我听说他昨天去了医院，不知道他是怎么去___。
en: I heard he went to the hospital yesterday; I do not know how he got there.

q: 你是怎么来___？
en: How did you get here?

q: 你是什么时候开始头疼___？
en: When did your headache start?

q: 你是坐地铁来的___？
en: Did you come by subway?

q: 你___坐地铁来的？
en: Did you come by subway?

q: 这封电子邮件是谁给你___？
en: Who sent you this email?

q: 我明天___坐地铁去医院。
en: I am going to the hospital by subway tomorrow.

q: 我下个星期六___坐火车去上海，不坐飞机。
en: Next Saturday I will go to Shanghai by train, not by plane.

q: 医生说我明天___去检查身体，所以今天晚上不能吃东西。
en: The doctor said I have to go for a check-up tomorrow, so I cannot eat tonight.
